blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. Across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks. Two unified models, BAGEL and Janus-Pro-7B, each lose accuracy on eight tasks. On VSTAR, adding a generated image to the same planning hint lowers accuracy by 10.47 points. Repeated image edits yield different outcomes across tasks. ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines, while ERQA gains three points after ten edits.
blocks.zh: 语言模型用文字思考;然后多模式模型可能用图像思考. 我们测试一个生成的帮助者是否改善了视觉问题的答案. 一个模型描述它需要的帮助者,然后用原始图像和生成的图像一起回答. 在13个视觉语言模型和发电机对中,一代的精确度下降3.7个百分点,10个任务中有9个下降。 BAGEL和Janus-Pro-7B两个统一型号,各自在8个任务上失去准确性. 在VSTAR上,在同一个规划提示上添加一个生成的图像会将精度降低10.47分. 重复的图像编辑在任务中产生不同的结果. ChartQAPro和MathVista都保持低于他们的"不生成"基线,而ERQA则在十次编辑后得到三分.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Long before we learned to write, we learned to draw: on cave walls tens of thousands of years ago, and again in every child’s first crayon drawing. And we never stop. A student stuck on a geometry problem draws one extra line, and the proof falls into place. At sixteen, Einstein imagined chasing a beam of light; ten years later, that picture became special relativity. Even without paper, we rotate and rearrange images in the mind’s eye, an ability we call imagination ( Kosslyn, 1996 ) . Pictures are not just something we look at; they are something we think with ( Larkin and Simon, 1987 ) . Now machines have learned to draw as well ( Esser et al., 2024 ; Labs, 2024 ; Google DeepMind, 2025a ) . If a machine can draw, can it also think by drawing?
blocks.zh: 早在我们学会写作之前,我们就学会了绘画:在上万年前的洞壁上,在每一个孩子的第一幅蜡笔画上,我们又重新画了画。 我们从不停止。 一个学生被困在几何问题上,画出一行外出,证据就到位了. 16岁时,爱因斯坦想象着追逐一束光;十年后,那张照片变成了特殊的相对论. 即使没有纸,我们也会在心灵的眼中旋转和重新排列图像,我们称之为想象力(Kosslyn,1996年)。 图片不仅仅是我们所看到的, 现在机器也学会了绘画(Esser等,2024;Labs,2024;Google DeepMind,2025a.). 如果机器能画画,它也能通过画来思考吗?

blocks.en: For now, vision-language models (VLMs) think almost entirely in words. They glance at an image once, then reason about it in long chains of text ( Liu et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2025b ) ; scaling them with chain-of-thought ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024b ) or long-context reinforcement learning ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025b ) makes those chains longer, but no less textual. Recent visual reasoning methods let models look again, cropping, zooming, and annotating the input mid-reasoning ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Su et al., 2025 ) . But looking again is not imagining. A student who draws that extra line is not zooming into the diagram; they are adding something that was never there. Image generators can add exactly such things, and early work shows that, with curated training data in narrow settings, generated images can help ( Li et al., 2025b ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Gu et al., 2025 ) . So we gave models a pencil and real problems. Mostly, they drew the wrong thing.
blocks.zh: 目前,视觉语言模型(VLMs)几乎完全用文字思考. 他们一看一看一眼,然后在长条文字链中说明原因(Liu等人,2023年;Bai等人,2025年b);用思维链加以放大。 (Shao等,2024;Zhang等,2024b)或长文强化学习(DeepSeek-AI,2025;Shen等,2025b)使这些链条更长,但文字不变. 近期的视觉推理方法让模型再次取景,裁剪,缩放,并注释输入的中合理性(胡等,2024;郑等,2025;苏等,2025. 但再看不是想象 一个画出额外线条的学生并没有放大到图表中;他们正在添加一些从未出现过的东西。 图像生成器可以完全添加这些东西,早期的研究表明,在狭义的环境下,通过整理训练数据,生成的图像可以有所帮助(Li等,2025b; Wu等,2025b;Gu等,2025.). 所以我们给了模特一个铅笔和真正的问题。 主要是他们画错了东西

blocks.en: Zebra-CoT ( Li et al., 2025a ) supplies interleaved text and image training data, and RealUnify ( Shi et al., 2025b ) studies how understanding and generation support each other in unified models. We use Reasoning with Imagination (Figure 2 ) to measure how a generated helper changes the answer to a visual question. In the first turn, a VLM writes a short hint describing an image that would help, such as zoom into the top-left panel and annotate the legend . A generator uses the hint and the input images to produce the helper. In the second turn, the VLM answers using the originals and the helper together. We compare each model with its own direct-answer baseline in both modular pipelines and unified models.
blocks.zh: Zebra-CoT (Li等,2025a) 提供互页文本和图像培训数据,Real Unify (Shi等,2025b) 研究在统一模型中如何理解和生成相互支持. 我们用"理性与想象"(图2)来衡量一个生成的帮助者如何改变一个视觉问题的答案. 在第一个转弯时,一个VLM会写出一个简短的提示来描述一个会有所帮助的图像,例如放大到左上方的面板并注释出传说. . 生成器使用提示和输入图像生成帮助器. 在第二回中,VLM用原作和帮助者一起回答. 我们在模块化管道和统一模型中,将每个模型与自己的直接回答基线进行比较。

blocks.en: We evaluate 13 VLM–generator pipelines and two unified models, BAGEL ( Deng et al., 2025 ) and Janus-Pro-7B ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , on nine benchmarks spanning ten tasks. Generation lowers accuracy in 106 of 130 modular pipeline–task comparisons, with losses of up to 31.3 points on VSTAR ( Wu and Xie, 2024 ) . Each unified model loses accuracy on eight tasks. BAGEL gains on MathVista ( Lu et al., 2024 ) and RoboSpatial-Compatibility ( Song et al., 2025a ) , while Janus gains on VisualPuzzles and Rover-TG.
blocks.zh: 我们评价13个VLM-发电机管线和两个统一型号,即BAGEL(Deng等人,2025年)和Janus-Pro-7B(Chen等人,2025年b),评估了跨越10个任务的9个基准。 在130个模块化管道中106个中,世代精度降低,任务比较,在VSTAR(Wu and Xie,2024)上损失可达31.3分. 每个统一的模型都丧失了8个任务的准确性. BAGEL在MathVista(Lu等,2024年)和RoboSpatial-compatiable(Song等,2025年a)上的收益,而Janus在VisualPuzzles和Rover-TG上的收益.

blocks.en: We examine where errors enter the pipeline, hold the planning turn fixed while changing the helper, and vary the number of generation calls (Section 5 ). • Hint and image quality. Of the failures we annotated, 66% had a bad hint, 28% a faulty image, and 6% an error in the final inference. On VSTAR, when the hint calls for a crop, applying it to the original pixels raises accuracy by 20.93 points over a generated edit. • Test-time scaling depends on the task. Extra text reasoning raises accuracy on two of three benchmarks. With up to ten image edits, ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines at every checkpoint. ERQA ends above baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们检查哪些错误进入管道,在更换帮助器时固定规划转弯,并改变生成次数(第5节)。 我们所注释的失败中,66%有不好的暗示,28%是错误的图像,6%是最终推断错误. 在 VSTAR 上,当提示要求一个裁剪时,将它应用到原始像素上,在生成的编辑上将精确度提高20.93分. ^ 测试时间的缩放取决于任务. 额外文字推理提高了三个基准中的两个的准确性。 ChartQAPro和MathVista的图像编辑最多可达10个,在每个检查站都低于其无代基线。 ERQA终止于基线以上.

blocks.en: Hint and image quality. Of the failures we annotated, 66% had a bad hint, 28% a faulty image, and 6% an error in the final inference. On VSTAR, when the hint calls for a crop, applying it to the original pixels raises accuracy by 20.93 points over a generated edit.
blocks.zh: 提示和图像质量。 我们所注释的失败中,66%有不好的暗示,28%有错误的图像,6%有最终推论错误. 在VSTAR上,当提示要求一个裁剪时,将其应用到原始像素上,在生成的编辑上将精确度提高20.93分.

blocks.en: Test-time scaling depends on the task. Extra text reasoning raises accuracy on two of three benchmarks. With up to ten image edits, ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines at every checkpoint. ERQA ends above baseline.
blocks.zh: 测试时间的缩放取决于任务. 额外文字推理提高了三个基准中的两个的准确性。 ChartQAPro和MathVista的图像编辑最多可达10个,在每个检查站都低于其无代基线。 ERQA终止于基线以上.

blocks.en: These comparisons distinguish failures in planning from failures in rendering the requested evidence. On VSTAR, even when the request stays the same, how the helper is produced changes the model’s answer.
blocks.zh: 这些比较区分了规划方面的失败和提供所要求的证据方面的失败。 在VSTAR上,即使请求保持不变,帮助者如何产生会改变模型的答案.

blocks.en: Figure 2: The Reasoning with Imagination pipeline. The VLM writes a hint, the generator draws a helper, and the VLM answers using evidence from the original images and the helper together.
blocks.zh: 图2: " 与想象有关的理性 " 管道。 VLM会写出提示,生成器会绘制一个帮助器,而VLM会利用原始图像和帮助器提供的证据来回答.

blocks.en: 2 Reasoning With Imagination
blocks.zh: 2 有想象力的理由

blocks.en: Reasoning with Imagination inserts one generated image into a VLM’s reasoning (Figure 2 ). The input is a visual question: one or more images and a question about them. Instead of answering directly, as in the text-only baseline, the model proceeds in three steps.
blocks.zh: 用想象力解释的原因将一个生成的图像插入VLM的推理(图2). 输入是一个视觉问题:一个或数个图像和关于它们的问题. 模型没有像文本唯一基准那样直接回答,而是分三个步骤进行.

blocks.en: In the first turn, the VLM receives the images and the question but is instructed not to answer yet. Instead, we prompt it to write a hint of one or two sentences describing a single helper image that would make the question easier, such as “zoom into the top-left panel and annotate the legend” or “rotate the first image to the right by 30 degrees.”
blocks.zh: 在第一个回合,VLM收到图像和问题,但被指示暂不回答. 相反,我们鼓励它写出一两句的提示来描述一个单一的帮助者图像,使问题变得容易,例如“左上方的面板和注释传说”或“将第一个图像旋转到右边30度。 “

blocks.en: An image generator draws the helper image from the hint and the input images. Generators that accept only one image edit the first input image; those that accept several see all of them. Unless stated otherwise, each question receives one helper image.
blocks.zh: 一个图像生成器从提示和输入图像中取出帮助者图像. 仅接受一个图像的生成器会编辑第一个输入图像;接受多个图像的生成器会看到所有图像. 除非另有说明,每个问题都得到一个帮助者图像。

blocks.en: The helper image is added to the same conversation in a second turn. The VLM then answers with the question, the original images, its hint, and the helper image all in context, and is asked to use evidence from every image. All prompts are in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 帮助者形象在第二回被加入到同一次对话中. VLM随后用问题,原始图像,它的提示,以及帮助者图像全部在上下文中解答,并被要求使用从每个图像得到的证据. 所有提示载于附录B。

blocks.en: In modular pipelines, a VLM plans and answers, and a separate generator produces the helper. In the unified setting, one model performs all three steps. For Janus-Pro-7B, we condition its generation head on the original image embeddings and the hint. The same backbone then answers from the original images, hint, and helper.
blocks.zh: 在模块化管道中,一个VLM计划和答案,以及一个单独的发电机产生帮助器. 在统一设置中,一个模型完成所有三个步骤. 对Janus-Pro-7B来说,我们以原始图像嵌入和提示作为其生成头部的条件. 同样的骨干从原始图像中解答,提示和帮助.

blocks.zh: 3个实验

blocks.en: We pair every VLM with every image generator in Table 2 , and pair Gemini 3.0 Flash ( Google DeepMind, 2025b ) with its own Nano-Banana, for 13 modular pipelines in total. We also evaluate BAGEL ( Deng et al., 2025 ) and Janus-Pro-7B ( Chen et al., 2025b ) as unified models. All models use non-thinking mode unless otherwise specified.
blocks.zh: 我们将每台VLM和每台图像生成器配对于表2, 将双子座 3.0 Flash(Google DeepMind, 2025b)配对为自己的Nano-Banana, 我们还评价BAGEL(Deng等人,2025年)和Janus-Pro-7B(Chen等人,2025年b)为统一模型。 除非另有说明,所有模型都使用非思维模式.

blocks.en: We evaluate on nine benchmarks covering six kinds of visual reasoning (Table 2 ). We exclude Rover-TG’s spatial-context task and ChartQAPro’s paragraph-context task.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了涵盖六种视觉推理的九项基准(表2)。 我们排除了Rover-TG的空间背景任务和ChartQAPro的段落背景任务。

blocks.en: We score answers by rule where possible. For responses requiring semantic scoring, the original experiments use Gemini-2.5-Flash ( Comanici et al., 2025 ) . The Janus-Pro-7B evaluation, matched controls, and extended scaling runs use Gemini-2.5-Flash-Lite. Prompts and inference settings appear in Appendix A and Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 我们尽可能按规则得分 对于需要语义评分的响应,原始实验使用双子座-2.5-Flash(Comanici等,2025年). Janus-Pro-7B评价,匹配控件,并扩展了缩放运行,使用双子座2.5-Flash-Lite. 提示和推断设置载于附录A和附录B。

blocks.en: 4 Drawing Is Not Yet Thinking
blocks.zh: 4 绘画不是在思考

blocks.en: Table 3 and Table 4 compare every pipeline with the text-only baseline of its VLM on ten tasks: the nine benchmarks, with RoboSpatial split into its compatibility and configuration questions.
blocks.zh: 表3和表4比较了每个管道及其关于10个任务的VLM的仅文本基线:9个基准,而RoboSpatial又分为了它的相容性和配置问题.

blocks.en: Across the 13 modular pipelines, generation lowers accuracy in 106 of the 130 results (82%); on average, accuracy falls by 3.7 points. In every pipeline, generation lowers accuracy on at least six of the ten tasks, and in 12 of the 13, on at least eight.
blocks.zh: 在13个模块化管道中,130个结果中的106个结果(82%)的生成精度下降;平均精度下降3.7分。 在每条管道中,一代至少会降低10项任务的6项,13项中的12项至少会降低8项。

blocks.en: The pattern holds for all four VLMs and all four generators. Gemini 3.0 Flash, which has the highest text-only accuracy on eight of the ten tasks, loses the most: paired with Nano-Banana, it drops on nine tasks, by 6.9 points on average, and gains on none. Doubling Qwen3-VL from 4B to 8B barely changes the average loss (3.4 vs. 3.2 points). Among generators, the strongest and proprietary Nano-Banana lose in 31 of its 40 results.
blocks.zh: 所有四台VLM和所有四台发电机都采用这种模式。 双子座 3.0 Flash在10个任务中的8个任务中只有文本精度最高,损失最多:与纳诺-巴拿纳配对,9个任务降分,平均得分6.9分,无得分. 将 Qune3-VL 从 4B 翻倍到 8B 勉强改变平均损失(3.4对3.2分). 在发电机中,最强和专有的纳诺-巴纳纳在40个结果中的31个失败.

blocks.en: On VSTAR, which asks about small objects in high-resolution images, generation lowers accuracy in every pipeline, by 3.8 to 31.3 points and by 21.0 on average. ChartQAPro, MathVista, and ERQA also decline in every pipeline, by 2.4, 5.3, and 4.3 points on average. In the annotated failures (Section 5 ), generators often lose fine details on ChartQAPro and VSTAR, while the hint often requests the wrong content on MathVista and ERQA.
blocks.zh: 在VSTAR上,它询问高分辨率图像中的小物体,每个管线的生成精度会降低3.8到31.3分,平均比21.0分. ChartQAPro、MathVista和ERQA在每条输油管中也平均下降2.4、5.3和4.3分。 在附加说明的失败(第5节)中,生成器经常在ChartQAPro和VSTAR上丢失精细的细节,而提示则经常在MathVista和ERQA上请求错误的内容.

blocks.en: RoboSpatial-Compatibility is the only task where generation helps consistently: accuracy rises in 12 of the 13 pipelines, by up to 23.8 points, and never falls. A plausible reason is that its questions are hypothetical (would an object fit in a given place?), so drawing the object in place depicts exactly the scene in question. Configuration questions from the same benchmark, which concern the scene as it is, decline in 12 of the 13 pipelines. Elsewhere, the remaining 11 gains are all small, at most 2.2 points.
blocks.zh: 机械空间相容性是唯一能持续地帮助发电的任务:准确性在13个管线中的12个提高,最高可达23.8分,永不下降. 一个合理的理由是,它的问题是假设性的(一个物体是否适合一个特定的地方?),因此,将所处物体画成准确的画面。 与现场有关的同一基准的配置问题在13个管道中的12个中下降。 在其他地方,剩余的11项收益都很小,最多达2.2分。

blocks.en: BAGEL gains on RoboSpatial-Compatibility (25.7 points) and MathVista (8.1), and its largest loss is on VSTAR (19.4 points). Across 5,906 paired questions, Janus-Pro-7B loses 9.52 points on RoboSpatial-Compatibility and 9.40 on MathVista. Its largest loss is on ERQA, from 34.50% to 20.25%. Its two gains are on VisualPuzzles (1.28 points) and Rover-TG (2.03 points).
blocks.zh: BAGEL在RoboSpatial-Compatiable(25.7分)和MathVista(8.1分)上的增益,其最大损失为VSTAR(19.4分). 横跨5,906个对接问题,Janus-Pro-7B在RoboSpatial-compatibility上损失了9.52分,在MathVista上损失了9.40分. 它的最大损失发生在ERQA上,从34.50%到20.25%. 其两项收益分别取自VisualPizzers (1.28分)和Rover-TG (2.03分).

blocks.en: 5 Why Does Generation Fail to Help?
blocks.zh: 5 为什么一代失败了?

blocks.en: Figure 3: Given the choice, the model rarely generates. Most annotated errors start with the hint. (a) Qwen3-VL calls the generator on fewer than 12% of examples under Selective-Gen , while Forced-Gen lowers accuracy on both benchmarks, most on VSTAR. (b) Share (%) of annotated failures by the step that went wrong, for Qwen (filled) and Gemini (open). Bad hints dominate spatial and embodied tasks. Bad generations dominate ChartQAPro and VSTAR.
blocks.zh: 图3:考虑到选择,该模型很少产生. 大多数注解错误从提示开始. (a) Quen3-VL在Selective-Gen 下使用不到12%的示例来调用生成器,而强制Gen则降低了两个基准的准确性,大多数是在VSTAR上. (b) Quen(填充)和双子座(开口)在错误步骤中分担附加说明的失败(%)。 错误的暗示支配着空间和内含的任务. 坏一代主导了ChartQAPro和VSTAR.

blocks.en: We labeled 10–20 failed examples per sampled benchmark by the step that went wrong (Figure 3 b). Among these examples, 66% had a bad hint, 28% a bad generation, and 6% an error in the final answer. On ChartQAPro and VSTAR, the generator often lost fine details that the hint identified correctly. On spatial, embodied, puzzle, and STEM tasks, a common error was a generic crop or zoom request that missed the information needed. Per-model results appear in Appendix C.4 .
blocks.zh: 我们用错误的步骤标出每个抽样基准10-20个失败的例子(图3b)。 在这些例子中,66%有不好的暗示,28%是不好的一代,6%是最终答案错误. 在ChartQAPro和VSTAR上,生成器经常丢失提示正确识别出的精细细节. 关于空间,包含,拼图,和STEM任务,一个常见错误是缺少所需信息的通用作物或缩放请求. 每个模型的结果载于附录C.4。

Figure 4: Generated helper images are rarely what the model needs. Each example shows the model’s answer, the input image, and the helper image generated from the model’s hint. (a) Correct answers occur despite visibly flawed helpers.
When the answer is wrong, the helper (b) misses the region the question asks about or (c) destroys evidence that was in the input.
blocks.zh:
图4:生成的帮助者图像很少是模型需要的. 每个例子都显示了模型的答案,输入图像,以及模型提示产生的帮助者图像. (a) 尽管有明显缺陷的帮助者,但正确答案仍然发生。
当回答错误时,帮助者(b) 错过问题所问的区域,或(c) 破坏输入中的证据。

blocks.en: Figure 4 shows errors in localizing a region, performing an edit, and reproducing a diagram. A model can also answer correctly in the presence of a visibly flawed helper. To measure the helper’s contribution, we compare answers to the same question while changing the image in the answer turn (Table 11 ).

blocks.en:
Table 5: Observed accuracy with fixed hints, reference helpers, and thinking mode. Accuracy (%) of Qwen3-VL 8B. (a) Nano-Banana generates an image from a fixed instruction for Jigsaw and Spatial (controlled prompt). Qwen receives the reference image directly for Jigsaw, Maze, and Multi-hop (oracle visual). (b) With FLUX.1-Kontext, generation lowers accuracy with thinking both on and off.
Green/red cells: above/below the gray baseline row of the same block (text-only, or text-only + thinking).

表5:以固定提示,参考帮助,和思维模式观察精度. 准确度(%)为Quen3-VL 8B. (a) 纳米-巴纳纳从固定指令中生成图像,用于Jigsaw和Space(控制快取)。 Quen直接为Jigsaw,Maze,和多跳(oracle vision)获得参考图像. (b) 使用FLUX.1-Kontext,生成的精度随着开关和关闭的思维而降低。
绿色/红色单元格:上/下同块的灰色基线行(只文本,或只文本+思考).

blocks.en: With Qwen3-VL 8B and Nano-Banana, a fixed task-specific hint yields accuracies 0.7 points above the direct-answer baseline on Jigsaw and 2.2 points above it on Spatial (Table 5 ). Supplying the reference helper directly yields gains of 2.5 points on Jigsaw, 5.1 on Maze, and 2.1 on Multi-hop. The table reports point estimates for each intervention. Appendix A describes both interventions.
blocks.zh: 使用Qune3-VL 8B和Nano-Banana,一个固定的任务提示比Jigsaw上的直接回答基线高0.7分,比Space上高2.2分(表5)。 提供参考帮助在Jigsaw、Maze和Multi-hop上直接得分2.5分。 该表列出了每项干预措施的估计数。 附 录 A描述了这两种干预措施。

blocks.en: Qwen3-VL 8B receives the same original inputs, hint, turn structure, and final instruction. The answer turn adds either no image, a second copy of the first original, or a FLUX.1-Kontext helper. On VSTAR, accuracy is 60.21%, 58.64%, and 49.74%, respectively. Compared with the hint alone, the generated helper introduces 28 errors and corrects eight, a loss of 10.47 points (paired 95% CI [ − 16.75 , − 4.71 ] [-16.75,-4.71] ). Compared with repeating the original, the loss is 8.90 points ( [ − 14.66 , − 2.62 ] [-14.66,-2.62] ). The paired intervals span zero on RoboSpatial-Compatibility ( + 1.90 +1.90 points, [ − 5.71 , 8.57 ] [-5.71,8.57] ) and ChartQAPro ( − 0.07 -0.07 , [ − 1.12 , 0.98 ] [-1.12,0.98] ).
blocks.zh: Qune3-VL 8B接收相同的原始输入,提示,转会结构,以及最终指示. 答案转会后会添加没有图像,第一个正本的第二个副本,或者FLUX.1-Kontext帮助器. 在VSTAR上,精度分别为60.21%,58.64%和49.74%. 仅与提示相比,生成的帮助者引入了28个错误并更正了8个,损失了10.47分(损失率为95% CI [−16.75,−4.71] [16.75,-4.71]),与重复原作相比,损失为8.90分([−14.66,−2.62] [14.66,-2.62] [14.66,-2.62]),对接间隔从机器人空间兼容性(+1.90+1.90分,[−5.71,8.57] [-5.71,8.57])和ChartQAPro(−0.07-0.07, [−1.12,0.98])上为零。

blocks.en: For hints that explicitly request a crop or zoom, Qwen locates the region on the first original image. We crop the original pixels and resize by bicubic interpolation to 1,024 pixels on the long side. On the same 43 VSTAR questions, cropping scores 72.09% and generation 51.16%, a 20.93-point advantage for cropping (95% CI [ 4.65 , 37.21 ] [4.65,37.21] ). We also instruct the planner to preserve task-relevant objects, text, numbers, and spatial relations. The same preservation hint scores 62.83% alone and 52.88% with a generated helper on VSTAR ( − 9.95 -9.95 points, 95% CI [ − 15.18 , − 4.19 ] [-15.18,-4.19] ). Table 11 reports all three benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 对于明确请求裁剪或缩放的提示,Quen在第一个原始图像上定位区域. 我们用二相插图来裁剪原始像素,并将大小调整到长边的1,024像素. 在相同的43个VSTAR问题上,收成为72.09%和发电为51.16%,是收成的20.93分优势(95% CI [4.65, 37.21] [4.65, 37.21]). 我们还指示规划者保留与任务有关的物体、文字、数字和空间关系。 同样的保值提示单得62.83%,在VSTAR上获得一个生成的帮助者52.88%(− 9.95-9.95分,95% CI [− 15.18分,− 4.19分] [15.18分, 4.19分]). 表11报告所有三个基准.

blocks.en: By default, the model always generates an image. When Qwen3-VL (4B or 8B) may choose, it calls the generator on 2–12% of questions and stays within 0.7 points of text-only accuracy. Generating for every question lowers accuracy by up to 12 points on VSTAR (Figure 3 a).
blocks.zh: 默认情况下,模型总是生成一个图像. 当Qune3-VL(4B或8B)可能选择时,它会用2-12%的问题给生成器打电话,并停留在只限文本准确度的0.7分以内. 在VSTAR(图3 a)上为每个问题生成最多12分的精度会降低.

(b) Share of annotated failures by the step that went wrong. (c) Chain-of-thought reasoning raises the same model’s accuracy on ChartQAPro and MathVista but lowers it on ERQA. (d) Mean change over all three benchmarks from adding text reasoning (as in c), one generation call (1 × \times Gen in a), or both (Table 5 ).

图5:文本推理和一至两代参考三个基准。 (a) 对于带有FLUX.1-Kontext的Qune3-VL 8B,第二代呼叫进一步降低了所有三项基准的准确性。 (b) 按错误步骤说明失败的比例。 (c) 思维链推理在ChartQAPro和MathVista上提高同一模型的准确性,但在ERQA上降低。 (d) 从增加文字推理(如c),一代调用(1×\times Gen in a),或两者兼而有之(表5)这三个基准的平均变化。

blocks.en: For Qwen3-VL 8B with FLUX.1-Kontext, extra text reasoning raises accuracy on ChartQAPro (15.8 points) and MathVista (2.5) and lowers it on ERQA (7.6). In the original one- and two-call comparison, the second generation lowers accuracy on all three (Figure 5 ). We reran the zero-, one-, and two-call conditions and extended the sequence to ten edits with a fixed hint (Appendix C.7 ). ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines at every evaluated round. ERQA rises from 42.50% at baseline to 45.50% after ten edits. Accuracy fluctuates across rounds on all three tasks.
blocks.zh: 对于配有FLUX.1-Kontext的Quen3-VL 8B,额外的文本推理提高了ChartQAPro(15.8分)和MathVista(2.5分)的精度并降低到ERQA(7.6分)上. 在最初的一对一和两对一的比较中,第二代降低了所有三个的准确性(图5. 我们重新设定了零,一,二调条件,并用固定提示(Appendix C.7.)将序列扩展至十个编辑. 图表 QAPro 和 MathVista 在每轮评估时都低于其不生成基线。 ERQA从基线的42.50%上升到了10个编辑后的45.50%. 准确性在所有三项任务上都相继波动.

blocks.en: With thinking mode turned on, generation still lowers accuracy on all three benchmarks (Table 5 ). The loss grows on ChartQAPro (from 2.1 to 5.4 points) and ERQA (1.5 to 7.9) and shrinks only on MathVista (3.9 to 2.9). Stronger reasoning in text alone does not make the generated images useful. Details are in Appendix C.6 .
blocks.zh: 随着思维模式的开通,一代仍然降低了所有三个基准的准确性(表5)。 损失在ChartQAPro(从2.1分到5.4分)和ERQA(从1.5分到7.9分)上增长,并只在MathVista(从3.9分到2.9分)上收缩. 单靠文本更强的推理并不能使生成的图像有用. 详情见附录C.6。

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en: Following advances in LLMs and large reasoning models ( Wei et al., 2023 ; DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ; Shen et al., 2025b ) , VLMs acquire reasoning ability via CoT decomposition ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025b ) and reinforcement finetuning ( Shen et al., 2025a ; Peng et al., 2025 ; Sarch et al., 2025 ) . Recent work ( Xu et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2025b ; Wu et al., 2025b ) treats images as active reasoning components, extracting task-centric signals such as bounding boxes, depth, and masks ( Hu et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) via SFT ( Zhang et al., 2024a ) or RFT ( Zheng et al., 2025 ; Su et al., 2025 ) . Visual thoughts are typically sourced from tool usage ( Fan et al., 2026 ; Hu et al., 2024 ; Shao et al., 2024 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Su et al., 2025 ) or code execution ( Vinker et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024a ; Liu et al., 2025 ; Fu et al., 2025 ) , both limited by tool coverage and the original input. Only a few works ( Xu et al., 2025b ; Li et al., 2025b ; Wu et al., 2025b ; Gu et al., 2025 ) explore image generation as an alternative, and only on narrow domains; whether models can reliably use generated visuals at scale remains open.
blocks.zh: 在LLMs和大型推理模型(Wei等,2023;DeepSeek-AI,2025;Shen等,2025b)取得进展后,VLMs通过CoT分解(Shao等,2024;Wang等,2025b)和加固微调(Shen等,2025a; 彭等,2025; Sarch等,2025.). 最近的工作(徐等,2025年b;李等,2025年b;吴等,2025年b)将图像视为活性推理成分,取出以任务为中心的信号,如边框,深度和口罩(胡等,2024年;邵等,2024年;刘等,2025年;傅等,2025年)通过SFT(张等,2024年a)或RFT(郑等,2025年;苏等,2025年). 视觉思维一般来源于工具使用(Fan等,2026;Hu等,2024;Shao等,2024;Zheng等,2025;Su等,2025)或代码执行(Vinker等,2024;Zhang等,2024a;Liu等,2025;Fu等,2025),均受工具覆盖和原始输入的限制. 只有少数著作(徐等,2025年b;李等,2025年b; Wu等, 2025b; Gu等, 2025 )作为替代品探索图像生成,并且只在狭义域上探索;模型是否能够可靠地使用所生成的视觉尺度仍然开放.

blocks.en: Unified multimodal models jointly handle understanding and generation in a single architecture ( Tong et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024b ; Ma et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025a ) , spanning autoregressive ( Dong et al., 2023 ; Team, 2024 ; Chern et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Pan et al., 2025 ; Xie et al., 2025 ) , diffusion-based ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2025a ; Swerdlow et al., 2025 ; Shi et al., 2025a ) , and hybrid ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Liao et al., 2025 ) designs. Building on LLM post-training ( DeepSeek-AI, 2025 ) , recent efforts apply CoT and RL to unified models for image editing and reasoning generation ( Duan et al., 2025 ; Chern et al., 2025 ; Jiang et al., 2025 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ) , showing gains when thinking in text before generating in vision. ThinkMorph ( Gu et al., 2025 ) extends this to visual-augmented reasoning using specialized data. We hold each reasoner fixed and compare its answers with and without its generated helper. The two unified models gain on different tasks.
blocks.zh: 统一的多模式模式在单一建筑中共同处理理解和生成问题(Tong等,2024;Wu等,2024b;Ma等,2025;Chen等,2025a),跨度自相递减(Dong等,2023;Team,2023;Team,2025;L. 2024; Chern等,2024;Wu等,2024a; Wang等人,2024年;Pan等人,2025年;Xie等人,2025年),以传播为主(Yang等人,2025年;Wang等人,2025年a;Swerdlow等人,2025年;Shi等人,2025年a)和杂交种(Zhou等人,2025年a)。 2024;谢等,2024;马等,2024;邓等,2025;廖等,2025.) 设计. 在LLM后培训的基础上(DeepSeek-AI,2025年),最近的努力将CoT和RL应用于图像编辑和推理生成的统一模型(Duan等,2025年;Chern等,2025年;Jiang等,2025年;Xiao等,2025年),在对文本进行思考后再产生视觉效果时显示出收获. ThinkMorph (Gu等, 2025年) 将此扩展至使用专门数据的可视化推理. 我们固定每个解释器,并将其答案与所生成的帮助器相提并论。 两种统一的模型在不同的任务上获得了收益.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Generated helpers lower accuracy in most of the modular and unified settings we tested. Even the two unified models gain on different tasks. On VSTAR, holding the hint fixed isolates a loss from the generated image, and cropping the requested region from the original pixels gives better answers. Repeated edits have task-dependent effects. ChartQAPro and MathVista remain below their no-generation baselines through ten edits, while ERQA finishes above baseline. These comparisons can also be applied to video reasoning and planning, where the evidence needed may change from one step to the next.
blocks.zh: 在我们测试的大多数模块化和统一设置中,生成的帮助者精度较低. 即使是两个统一的模型也获得了不同的任务. 在 VSTAR 上,持有提示固定从生成的图像中分离出一个损失,从原始像素中裁剪请求的区域给出更好的答案. 重复编辑具有任务依赖的效果. ChartQAPro和MathVista通过十次编辑仍然低于其无代基线,而ERQA则完成于基线. 这些比较也可以应用于视频推理和规划,因为所需要的证据可能从一个步骤变为下一个步骤。

blocks.en: This section summarizes evaluation settings for both modular VLM–generator pipelines and unified multimodal models.
blocks.zh: 本节概述了模块化VLM-生成器管道和统一多模式的评价设置。

blocks.en: For all VLM evaluations, we fix the random seed for reproducibility. Unless otherwise specified, decoding uses a temperature of 0.1 0.1 , top- p p sampling with p = 1.0 p=1.0 , and a maximum token budget of 8192 8192 , which is sufficient to accommodate the longer reasoning chains required by benchmarks such as MathVista and VisualPuzzles without truncation.
blocks.zh: 对于所有VLM评价,我们定出可复制的随机种子. 除非另有说明,解码使用0.1的温度,上-p采样为p=1.0p=1.0,最高代号预算为8192 8192,足以满足MathVista和VisualPizzles等基准要求的更长的推理链而无需截取.

blocks.en: In the modular VLM–generator setting, inference proceeds in two stages. In Turn 1 , the VLM produces a generation hint describing the desired auxiliary visual content. We use a temperature of 0.1 0.1 , top- p = 1.0 p=1.0 , and a token budget of 2048 2048 for this stage. The hint is then passed to an external image generator to produce a helper image.
blocks.zh: 在模块化的VLM-生成器设定中,推论分两个阶段进行. 在Turn 1中,VLM产生一代提示来描述所期望的辅助视觉内容. 我们使用的温度为0.1,最高-p=1.0p=1.0,这一阶段的象征性预算为2048 2048. 然后提示传递给外部图像生成器,以生成一个帮助者图像.

blocks.en: For Stable Diffusion 3.5, we use 28 denoising steps, guidance scale 5.0 5.0 , and strength 0.6 0.6 for image-to-image generation. For FLUX.1-Kontext, we use 28 denoising steps, guidance scale 2.5 2.5 , and CFG scale 1.0 1.0 . In Turn 2 , the VLM receives both the original inputs and the generated helper image and produces the final answer using the same decoding settings as in text-only inference. blocks.zh: 附录C 实验

blocks.en: C.1 Generator Capability
blocks.zh: C.1 发电机能力

blocks.en: We further investigate whether the limited gains of visual generation stem from the generator’s capability rather than the reasoning model. Concretely, we perform a focused case study that stratifies tasks by difficulty and contrasts scenarios where image generation is expected to be sufficient (simple perceptual edits) against those requiring complex manipulations or structured visual outputs. Unless otherwise specified, experiments in this subsection use Qwen3-VL 8B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) as the reasoning model and Nano-Banana ( Google DeepMind, 2025a ) as the image generator. We chose two tasks, a perception-heavy jigsaw task and a structured math-geometry task, and control the generation hint to be minimal short prompts without any reasoning involved.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步调查视觉生成的有限收益是否来自发电机的能力,而不是推理模型。 具体地说,我们进行一项重点突出的案例研究,通过困难来分解任务,并将预期图像生成足够(简单感知编辑)的情景与需要复杂操纵或结构化视觉输出的情景作对比。 除非另有说明,本分节中的实验使用Quen3-VL 8B(Bai等,2025a)作为推理模型并使用Nano-Banana(Google DeepMind,2025a)作为图像生成器. 我们选择了两个任务,一个是感知重的拼接任务和一个结构化的数学几何任务,并且控制生成提示成为最小的短提示而不涉及任何推理.

To assess reliability, we compare it against (1) rule-based evaluation on benchmarks with deterministic answer formats, and (2) human annotations on a randomly sampled set of 100 instances drawn from all datasets. blocks.en: The two evaluators yield closely matching aggregate accuracies, with identical scores on VSTAR and a difference of only 0.4 percentage points on ChartQAPro.

blocks.en: On the 100-instance sample set, Gemini-2.5-Flash scores 37.0 versus human evaluation at 39.0, a 2-point difference well within the margin of inter-annotator variation. We additionally rerun Gemini-2.5-Flash three times on ChartQAPro and VSTAR, observing a standard deviation of 0.97 percentage points across runs. Together, these checks confirm that our evaluation judge is robust and that findings are not an artifact of judge design.

blocks.en: C.3 Multi-Turn vs. KV-Cache Inference
blocks.zh: C.3 多回合对 KV- 缓存推论

blocks.en: Once the helper image has been produced, we compare two implementations for feeding it back to the VLM. Multi-turn inference adds it in a new conversational turn and re-encodes the full context, including the question, original images, hint, and helper image. KV-cache inference instead reuses the cached prefix and processes the appended image tokens. We compare these implementations on VSTAR, ERQA, and SAT using Qwen3-VL 8B paired with Qwen-Image-Edit.
blocks.zh: 一旦帮助者图像被制作出来,我们比较了两个执行,以将其反馈到VLM. 多回合推论将其添加到一个新的对话回合中,并重新编码了整个上下文,包括问题,原始图像,提示,和帮助者图像. KV- cache 推论可以重用已缓存的前缀, 并处理附加的图像符号 。 我们比较了这些在VSTAR,ERQA,和SAT上的应用,使用Quen3-VL 8B与Quen-Image-Edit对等.

blocks.en: Across all three benchmarks, the multi-turn implementation outperforms the KV-cache implementation: 50.8 vs. 32.4 on VSTAR (+18.4), 38.5 vs. 18.7 on ERQA (+19.8), and 61.6 vs. 45.8 on SAT (+15.8). We therefore use multi-turn inference for all main experiments. These results compare the two evaluated implementations; they do not establish an inherent limitation of KV caching. Under causal attention, recomputing an unchanged prefix does not let earlier tokens attend to a later helper image. The source of the observed gap remains unresolved.
blocks.zh: 在所有三项基准中,多回合执行的绩效超过了KV-cache的执行:在VSTAR(+18.4)方面,50.8对32.4;在ERQA(+19.8)方面,38.5对18.7;在SAT(+15.8)方面,61.6对45.8。 因此,我们对所有主要实验都采用多轮推论。 这些结果比较了两个评价的执行情况;它们没有确立KV缓存的固有限制。 在因果注意下,重算一个不变的前缀不会让更早的符记关注后期的帮助者图像. 所观察到的差距的来源仍未解决。

blocks.en: Even with multi-turn inference, accuracy remains below the text-only baseline (81.6 / 44.3 / 70.1). Thus, the main finding holds under the better-performing implementation: generated helper images still reduce accuracy on these three benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 即使进行了多轮推论,准确性仍然低于仅以文字为准的基准(81.6/44.3/70.1)。 因此,主要结论是执行得更好:生成的帮助者图像仍然降低了这三项基准的准确性。

blocks.en: C.4 Detailed Failure Attribution
blocks.zh: C.4 详细的失败归属

blocks.en: In the annotated sample, 76% of Qwen3-VL failures and 57% of Gemini failures stem from bad hints, while 21% (Qwen) and 36% (Gemini) come from bad generation; pure inference failures are negligible. Per-task ranges sharpen the dichotomy reported in Section 5 : chart and visual-search tasks (ChartQAPro, VSTAR) reach 50–90% bad generation, while spatial, embodied, puzzle, and STEM tasks (ERQA, MathVista, SAT, VisualPuzzles, Rover) reach 70–100% bad hints. Stylistically, Gemini more frequently produces tool-like hints (e.g., Python-style editing instructions) while Qwen3-VL produces shorter, under-specified ones; despite this stylistic difference, both models exhibit the same task-dependent split.
blocks.zh: 在附加说明的样本中,76%的Quen3-VL故障和57%的双子座故障出自坏提示,而21%(Quen)和36%(Gemini)出自坏一代;纯推论故障可忽略不计. 每个任务范围使第5节中报告的二分法更加清晰:图和可视化搜索任务(ChartQAPro,VSTAR)达到50-90%的坏生成,而空间,内含,谜题,和STEM任务(ERQA,MathVista,SAT,VisualPizzers,Rover)达到70-100%的坏提示. 风格上,双子座更经常地产生类似工具的提示(如Python风格的编辑指令),而Qun3-VL则产生更短,规格不足的提示;尽管有这种风格上的差异,两种模型都表现出相同的任务依赖分出.

blocks.zh: C.5 详细定性案例研究

The paired comparisons in Appendix C.8 measure how often a different helper changes the outcome for the same question. Among failed cases, some hints identify the wrong region. Other hints identify the right evidence, but the generator alters it during a precise edit or while reconstructing a diagram.
blocks.zh: 在图4中,正确答案有时会伴有不准确的帮助者. 示例可以识别帮助器中的明显错误. 附录C.8中的对等比较衡量了不同帮助者为同一问题改变结果的频率。 在失败的案件中,有些提示会识别出错误的区域. 其他提示识别正确的证据,但生成器在精确编辑或重建图表时会修改.

blocks.en: C.6 Detailed Thinking-Mode Results
blocks.zh: C.6 详细的思维模式结果

blocks.en: For text-only inputs, thinking yields ChartQAPro + + 15.8 (40.8 → \to 56.6) and MathVista + + 2.5 (61.2 → \to 63.7) but hurts ERQA ( − - 7.6, 44.3 → \to 36.7). Adding visual augmentation without thinking already degrades all three (FLUX.1: ChartQAPro − - 2.1, MathVista − - 3.9, ERQA − - 1.5, from 44.3 to 42.8), and enabling thinking does not recover the gap and sometimes widens it ( − - 5.4, − - 2.9, − - 7.9 respectively). On harder reasoning tasks, longer reasoning over the generated image may even amplify the noise the synthetic visual injects.

blocks.en: Appendix D Limitations
blocks.zh: 附录D 限制

blocks.en: Our study evaluates static image generators and omits two adjacent paradigms that may unlock cases where stills fall short: video generators and world-model / simulator generators , which can render dynamics, action consequences, and counterfactual rollouts that single-frame edits cannot. Whether these temporally grounded generators sidestep the hint and image errors observed here is an open question we leave to future work. Our evaluation is also confined to question-answering benchmarks ; visual generation may play a different and possibly more load-bearing role in non-QA settings such as long-horizon planning, agentic execution, dialog, or open-ended generation, where intermediate visual artifacts are themselves part of the output rather than an aid to a single answer. Extending the framework to instruction-tuned reasoning-specialist VLMs and to longer multi-turn text–image–text–image trajectories is another natural direction.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究评价了静态图像生成器,省略了两个相邻的范式,这些范式可能解锁了静态不足的病例:视频生成器和世界模型/模拟生成器,它们可以使动态,动作后果,以及反事实的展开成为单帧编辑无法完成的. 这些基于时间的生成器是否绕过这里观察到的提示和图像错误是一个有待我们考虑的问题。 我们的评价也仅限于问答基准;视觉生成可能在非质量评估环境中发挥不同而且可能更能负载的作用,例如长视距规划,代理执行,对话,或无限制的一代,中间视觉出品本身是输出的一部分,而不是对单一答案的帮助. 将框架扩大到指导性调整推理专家VLM,以及更长的多回合文本-图像-文本-图像轨迹,是另一个自然方向。

blocks.en: Appendix E Broader Impact
blocks.zh: 附录E 更广泛的影响

blocks.en: This work studies the integration of visual generation into multimodal reasoning systems and finds that generated visual evidence does not consistently improve reasoning and may even degrade performance in structured tasks. These insights can inform the design of more reliable systems and guide when generation should be used.
blocks.zh: 这部作品研究了将视觉生成融入多模式推理系统的问题,并发现所生成的视觉证据并不能持续地改善推理,甚至可能降低结构化任务中的性能. 这些见解可以为设计更可靠的系统提供参考,并指导何时应使用生成。

blocks.en: At the same time, incorporating generated images introduces risks. Generated content may contain hallucinated or misleading details, which could be interpreted as valid evidence, especially in high-stakes settings such as healthcare or autonomous systems. There is also potential for misuse, such as generating visually plausible but incorrect evidence.
blocks.zh: 同时,纳入生成的图像带来了风险。 生成的内容可能包含有幻觉或误导性的细节,可被解释为有效证据,特别是在保健或自主系统等高吸取环境下. 也有滥用的可能,例如产生明显可信但错误的证据。

blocks.en: We encourage future work on improving the reliability of visual generation, incorporating verification mechanisms, and explicitly modeling uncertainty in multimodal reasoning systems.
blocks.zh: 我们鼓励今后努力提高视觉生成的可靠性,纳入核查机制,并明确模拟多式联运推理系统的不确定性。
